title: Maria's Healthy Day
text:
Maria wants to be healthy. She eats fruit every day. She drinks a lot of water. She goes to the park with her dog.

Maria sleeps eight hours every night. She goes to bed early. In the morning, she feels happy and has energy. Her friends say she looks very healthy.

questions.text: What does Maria eat every day?
How many hours does Maria sleep every night?
Why does Maria feel happy in the morning?
What kind of person is Maria?

vocabulary.definition: in good physical condition and not sick
a clear liquid that people drink
a public place with grass and trees where people walk and play

paragraph_translations: Maria quer ser saudável. Ela come frutas todos os dias. Ela bebe muita água. Ela vai ao parque com o seu cachorro.
Maria dorme oito horas todas as noites. Ela vai para a cama cedo. De manhã, ela se sente feliz e tem energia. Os amigos dizem que ela parece muito saudável.
